references.text: Jesus' direct answer to the Jews' doubt about how He can give His flesh to eat, by explaining that it is necessary to eat the Son of Man's flesh to have life.
A similar reaction from the disciples as from the Jews in verse 52, where they ask: "This is a hard saying; who can hear it?"
Earlier in the same chapter, the Jews express similar doubt and grumble against Jesus because He claims to be "the bread that came down from heaven".
The source of the doubt in verse 52 is Jesus' claim in the previous verse that He is the living bread and that "my flesh is true food".
